item.title: What Exactly Is an AI Agent?
item.description:

The word "agent" is everywhere right now, and most of the time it's marketing. So let's be precise: an AI agent is software that perceives its environment, makes decisions, and takes actions toward a goal — without a human in the loop for every step.

item.title: INT4 Absmax Quantization: One Outlier Zeroed 4,095 of 4,096 Values
item.description:
I planted one number in a vector of 4,096 floats. I set it to 60, quantized the vector to INT4 with absmax scaling, and looked at what was left.

All 4,095 of the other values were exactly zero.

Not "a bit noisy." Zero. The whole row went down to one integer level, plus the outlier.
